annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that a client may repeat the request only if it adds a syntactically and semantically valid Content-Length header field that specifies the length of the request payload data. The requirement that the header field contain the length of the payload data implies that the payload data must be the same as originally sent, leaving no materially different implementation interpretations or missing constraints.
